warnings: ISO datasets are structurally import-ready for development/QA but are not eligible for official compliance use until licensed content is supplied and human review gates pass.
The v1 catalog represented 131 Annex A controls as Requirements. v1.1 corrects this by materializing them as regulatory_reference Control/ControlVersion plus NormativeUnitControlMapping.
532 mixed Requirement<->reference-control crosswalk candidates are quarantined because the rector contract permits only typed RequirementCrosswalk and ControlCrosswalk mappings.
681 mappings from pseudo-Requirements (Annex controls) to TCDX baseline controls are quarantined; no Control-to-Control semantic mapping is invented.
Official completeness of ISO normative text is not asserted. structural_dataset_coverage_percent refers only to normalization coverage of v1 records.
